question: Since Reinhard became Felt’s knight, I think there have been several changes in Reinhard himself, such as him taking up gardening. Among these changes, have Flam and Grassis ever felt that Reinhard in particular has changed since becoming Felt’s knight?
answer:
Flam and Gassis are the twin children of the Remendis family, which serves the Astrea family. Since they are twelve years old, Reinhard has known them since they were born, so their relationship is almost like that of family.

After becoming Felt’s knight, Felt, being the kind of character she is, has been rather vocal with Reinhard about various things. One of those things is “playing around with the soil” (gardening).

When Theresia-san was still around, the flower beds were extremely beautiful, filled with flowers. But those flower beds have now fallen into a completely overgrown state. After seeing them, Felt told Reinhard, “Why don’t you try planting some flowers or something?” And now, Reinhard has made tending to the flower beds part of his daily routine, using a Divine Protection along the lines of “the Divine Protection of ~~~ for tending the soil”.

Speaking of things related to that, there is also an episode where Felt likes sweets, so she enjoys having Reinhard make sweets for her and then eating them. Since Reinhard has had more opportunities to stand in the kitchen and cook, Flam and Grassis feel that “the Young Master often cooks right beside us, happily humming to himself,” and that Reinhard seems to be having more fun than he used to.
